challenges.title: Hello Map
challenges.prompt: Build a minimal Mapbox GL JS page: full-viewport #map, mapbox://styles/mapbox/standard, center on Prague [14.4178, 50.1167], zoom 12. Use mapbox-gl v3.9.0 from CDN (unpkg or jsDelivr). Load access token from ../admin-boundaries/js/config.js (window.MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN). Guard missing token before constructing the map. Do not hardcode a pk. token.

challenges.title: Fog and Lights
challenges.prompt: Mapbox GL JS v3.9.0 map with fog (setFog) and either lights config or Standard style lightPreset (day/dusk/night/dawn). Full-viewport #map, token from config.js with missing-token guard.

challenges.title: Terrain Fly
challenges.prompt: Map with Mapbox terrain-dem source, setTerrain with exaggeration > 1, pitch ~60, flyTo Alps (~[8.6, 46.5]). GL JS v3.9.0, token from config.

challenges.title: Style Switcher
challenges.prompt: UI with at least 3 Mapbox style buttons (e.g. standard, outdoors-v12, satellite-streets-v12). Call map.setStyle on click and re-attach layers/handlers on style.load. GL JS v3.9.0 + config token.

challenges.title: Geocode Roundtrip
challenges.prompt: Forward geocode an address (Mapbox Geocoding API v5 or Search Box) and reverse geocode a click. Show results in the UI. Debounce the search input. Token from config; GL JS map optional but preferred.

challenges.title: Directions Line
challenges.prompt: Call Mapbox Directions API for a driving route between two fixed points, draw the geometry as a GeoJSON line layer on a Mapbox GL JS map. Token from config. Handle fetch errors.

challenges.title: 3D Buildings
challenges.prompt: Add a fill-extrusion layer for 3D buildings using Mapbox composite building data (or Standard buildings). Data-driven height expression. Insert under labels when using classic styles. Pitch the camera. Token from config.

challenges.title: Clustered Points
challenges.prompt: Generate ~5000 random points near a city, add as GeoJSON source with cluster:true, and render clustered + unclustered circle layers (has point_count / !has). Token from config. GL JS v3.9.0.

challenges.title: Store Locator
challenges.prompt: Store locator: search input (Mapbox geocoding/Search), list of ≥8 store markers from GeoJSON, flyTo on list click, popup on marker click, optional clustering. Production-ish UI. Token from config.

challenges.title: Search to Route
challenges.prompt: Full UX: geocode origin + destination inputs, call Directions API, draw route line, show distance/duration in UI from the route object (route.distance / route.duration), error handling. Bias geocoding with proximity near the map center (e.g. proximity=-77.0369,38.9072 for DC) so ambiguous names like Lincoln Memorial resolve locally — not Lincoln Memorial Parkway in Illinois. Token from config.

challenges.title: Matrix ETAs
challenges.prompt: One origin + ≥5 destinations. Call Mapbox Matrix API (driving). Display ETA table in the UI and mark destinations on the map. Token from config. Handle errors.

challenges.title: Isochrone Polygons
challenges.prompt: Mapbox Isochrone API: polygons for 15/30/60 minute contours (walking or driving). Draw as fill layers with opacity. Click or geolocate sets origin. Token from config.

challenges.title: Perf Checklist
challenges.prompt: Demonstrate Mapbox web performance patterns: prefer symbol/circle layers over HTML Marker for large sets, use cluster:true, debounce moveend/geocode handlers (clearTimeout), and remove map on page teardown (map.remove). Comment or UI checklist of patterns used. Token from config.

challenges.title: MapLibre Migration Honesty
challenges.prompt: HTML page documenting Mapbox GL JS ↔ MapLibre migration: show side-by-side code (or clearly labeled sections) for accessToken vs no token, mapbox:// style URL vs open style, and package name change. Include a working Mapbox GL map (token from config) AND note what would change for MapLibre. No fake APIs.

challenges.title: React Mapbox Map
challenges.prompt: React (TSX) Mapbox GL JS map component: useRef container, useEffect to construct mapboxgl.Map with mapbox://styles/mapbox/streets-v12, set mapboxgl.accessToken from import.meta.env.VITE_MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN (not a hardcoded pk.). Cleanup with map.remove() on unmount. Guard missing token. Pin mapbox-gl conceptually (comment or package note v3.9.x).

challenges.title: deck.gl on Mapbox
challenges.prompt: HTML page: Mapbox GL JS v3.9.0 basemap + deck.gl ScatterplotLayer (or HexagonLayer) via MapboxOverlay. Prefer the unpkg deck.gl UMD bundle (or esm.sh) — do NOT use jsDelivr npm/@deck.gl/.../+esm (that path throws makeBatchFromTable at runtime). Token from ../admin-boundaries/js/config.js. At least 50 synthetic points. map.on('error') or visible error UI.

challenges.title: Mapbox GL Draw
challenges.prompt: Mapbox GL JS map with @mapbox/mapbox-gl-draw: enable polygon + line draw modes, listen for draw.create, show drawn feature count or GeoJSON length in the UI. Token from config. GL JS v3.9.0.

challenges.title: iOS SwiftUI Mapbox
challenges.prompt: SwiftUI snippet using MapboxMaps: Map(initialViewport:), style URI mapbox://styles/mapbox/streets-v12 (or Standard), access token from Info.plist / .xcconfig (MBXAccessToken) — never hardcode pk. in source. Show a Marker or MapViewAnnotation. Mention MapboxMaps import.

challenges.title: Android Compose Mapbox
challenges.prompt: Jetpack Compose Mapbox map: MapboxMap / MapViewportState, Point(lng, lat) order, style mapbox://styles/mapbox/streets-v12, INTERNET permission in AndroidManifest snippet, token from BuildConfig or local.properties — not a pk. literal in Kotlin.

challenges.title: Flutter Mapbox
challenges.prompt: Flutter Dart: MapWidget from mapbox_maps_flutter, styleURI MapboxStyles.STREETS or mapbox://styles/mapbox/streets-v12, ACCESS_TOKEN from String.fromEnvironment or similar — no pk. literal. CameraOptions with center Point.

challenges.title: React Native Mapbox
challenges.prompt: React Native TSX using @rnmapbox/maps (MapView, Camera, PointAnnotation or ShapeSource). Set Mapbox.setAccessToken from Config / env — no hardcoded pk. StyleURL.Street or mapbox://styles/mapbox/streets-v12. Cleanup notes OK.

challenges.title: Google Maps Migration
challenges.prompt: HTML guide + working Mapbox map: document Google Maps → Mapbox equivalents (google.maps.Map → mapboxgl.Map, LatLng → [lng,lat], DirectionsService → Directions API, places → Search/Geocoding). Include a live Mapbox GL JS map (token from config). Call out lng/lat order trap.
